Anil Gupta
Talent Acquisition Specialist | Pune
anil.gupta108@example.com | +91 9878082753

Summary
Driven Talent Acquisition Specialist with experience managing full-cycle hiring for technology roles and improving candidate experience across fast-paced teams. Skilled at sourcing through LinkedIn Recruiter, coordinating with hiring managers in Workday, and streamlining onboarding processes. Open to relocating to Kolkata. Notice period: 15 days.

Experience
Freshworks — Mar 2026 - Present
Talent Acquisition Specialist (Remote/Hybrid)
- Managed end-to-end recruitment for product and engineering roles using LinkedIn Recruiter and Workday, filling 18 roles in the first 6 months with an average time-to-offer of 22 days.
- Implemented structured interview scorecards in Confluence and tracked feedback in Jira, reducing candidate follow-up time by 30% and improving hiring manager satisfaction scores.
- Led onboarding coordination for new hires via Workday and Confluence, decreasing onboarding completion time from 7 days to 4 days and achieving 95% completion rate for required training in the first week.
- Sourced passive candidates and ran targeted outreach campaigns on LinkedIn Recruiter that increased qualified pipeline by 40% quarter-over-quarter.

Projects
- Campus Outreach Initiative: Partnered with university contacts to run virtual hiring drives, resulting in 12 early-career hires and a 25% conversion rate from offer to acceptance.
- Onboarding Template Library: Created a set of role-specific onboarding checklists in Confluence that standardized the first 30 days for new employees and cut manager setup time by 50%.

Skills
Recruitment: Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, LinkedIn Recruiter
HR Systems: Workday, Onboarding
Collaboration & Tools: Confluence, Jira

Education
MBA (Finance), NMIMS
